shellCommands.command: ls -la && echo "---" && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -200 && echo "---" && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null | head -100

sed -n '1,80p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "--- GREP charts/chartkit ---" && rg -n -C 4 -i 'chartkit|@gravity-ui/charts|timeseries|time series|line chart' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -150 && echo "--- SRC ---" && cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json && echo "--- node_modules gravity ---" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/

rg -n -C 3 -i 'yagr' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -60; echo "--- npm view ---"; npm view @gravity-ui/charts version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -40; npm view @gravity-ui/yagr version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -40; echo "--- git status / lock ---"; git status --short | head; ls node_modules | head -50 | tr '\n' ' '

npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '
 ' | head -c 2000; echo; for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[]", ' | tail -12); do echo -n "charts@$v peers: "; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '
 ' ; echo; done; echo "--- yagr ---"; npm view @gravity-ui/yagr versions --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '
 ' | tail -c 600; echo; npm view @gravity-ui/yagr@5.3.1 peerDependencies dependencies --json 2>/dev/null; echo "--- uikit installed ---"; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version"

npm install --save-exact @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0 @gravity-ui/yagr@5.3.1 2>&1 | grep -v 'npm warn Unknown env config' | tail -20; echo "--- installed ---"; node -p "['charts','yagr','uikit'].map(p=>p+'@'+require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json').version).join(' ')"; echo "--- deps of charts ---"; node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json').dependencies)"; git diff --stat -- package.json

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/ ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/build/docs 2>&1 | head -40; echo "--- README charts ---"; wc -l node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; echo "=== get-started ==="; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/get-started.md | head -150

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md; echo "=== yagr typings ==="; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/typings node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist | head -40; node -p "const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json'); JSON.stringify({main:p.main,module:p.module,types:p.types,exports:p.exports,style:p.style,sideEffects:p.sideEffects},null,1)"

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/react.d.ts; echo "=== index.d.ts ==="; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/index.d.ts | head -60; echo "=== types.d.ts (timeline/series/theme/ Config) ==="; rg -n 'timeline|export (type|interface) (Config|YagrConfig|Series|Settings|Theme|Axis)|theme|height|width|adaptive|tooltip' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/types.d.ts | head -60

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore; ls $D | head -50; echo "=== MinimalValidConfig / types ==="; rg -n 'MinimalValidConfig|export (interface|type) (Config|Settings|Series|Axis|Timeline|ValidConfig|Scale)' $D/types.d.ts | head -40

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore; sed -n '1,110p' $D/types.d.ts; echo "=== series ==="; sed -n '230,300p' $D/types.d.ts; echo "=== common/other key config ==="; rg -n 'export interface YagrConfig|timeline|theme|adaptive|height|nolegend|legend|cursor|tooltip|dataSpan|Plugins|plugins|axes|scales' $D/types.d.ts | head -60

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore; sed -n '160,230p' $D/types.d.ts; echo "=== YagrTheme ==="; rg -n 'YagrTheme' -A4 $D/types.d.ts | head -20; rg -n 'YagrTheme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist -l | head; echo "=== RawSerieData ==="; sed -n '300,302p' $D/types.d.ts; echo "=== legend/cursor opts ==="; sed -n '1,40p' $D/plugins/legend/legend.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo "=== charts dist ==="; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist | head -30; echo "=== Chart props ==="; rg -n 'export (declare )?(const|function|interface|type) (Chart\b|ChartProps|ChartData|ChartKitProps)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist --glob '*.d.ts' | head -20

sed -n '1,40p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/components/index.d.ts; echo "=== ChartData ==="; sed -n '35,60p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/index.d.ts; echo "=== docs: list ==="; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes 2>/dev/null

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs; ls $D/series-types; echo "=== axis-types (head) ==="; sed -n '1,90p' $D/guides/axes/axis-types.md; echo "=== line series (head) ==="; sed -n '1,70p' $D/series-types/line.md 2>/dev/null

rg -n 'xAxis|yAxis' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/index.d.ts | head -12; echo "=== datetime example in docs ==="; rg -n -B3 -A25 "type: 'datetime'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/examples.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-labels.md 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo "=== series type line / area in types ==="; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/ | head -40

sed -n '95,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/index.d.ts; rg -n 'export interface ChartXAxis|export interface ChartYAxis|export interface LineSeries|export interface ChartSeries|export interface ChartLineSeries|export type ChartSeriesData|export interface ChartSeriesDataItem' -A12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/*.d.ts | head -120

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup Loader Text Flex Card useThemeType ThemeProvider 2>&1 | head -80; echo "=== css side effects ==="; rg -n "index.css|\.css'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/react.mjs node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs 2>/dev/null | head -5; rg -l "\.css" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/index.js 2>/dev/null | head -3; rg -n "css" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/theming.md | head -8

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; rg -n "export declare const (SegmentedRadioGroup|Loader|useThemeType|Card)\b|export \{[^}]*\bSegmentedRadioGroup\b" $U/build --glob '*.d.ts' 2>/dev/null | head -10; rg -n "useThemeType" $U/build --glob '*.d.ts' | head -5; echo "=== SegmentedRadioGroup props ==="; F=$(rg -l "SegmentedRadioGroupProps" $U/build --glob '*.d.ts' | head -1); echo "file=$F"; rg -n "interface SegmentedRadioGroupProps" -A25 $F | head -40; echo "=== yagr react css ==="; grep -c "css" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/react.mjs; grep -o 'import[^;]*\.css[^;]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/*.mjs | head -3; grep -o 'import[^;]*\.css[^;]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/index.js | head -3; echo "=== charts theming css mention ==="; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm | head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; F=$(rg -l "interface ControlGroupProps" $U --glob '*.d.ts' | head -1); echo "file=$F"; rg -n "interface ControlGroupProps" -A22 $F | head -40; rg -n "ThemeType\b" $U/components/theme/*.d.ts | head -4; echo "=== Loader props ==="; rg -n "size\?" $U/components/Loader/Loader.d.ts | head -3; echo "=== yagr index.css head ==="; head -c 300 node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/index.css; echo; echo "=== charts LineSeries connectNulls? ==="; rg -n "connectNulls|spanGaps|nullValue|null" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts | head -8

cd /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.319/f661ef338bd1a6dfcca2b89320f88f24/dataviz && sed -n '1,200p' references/palette.md | head -220; echo "=== validator usage ==="; node scripts/validate_palette.js --help 2>&1 | head -30

cd /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.319/f661ef338bd1a6dfcca2b89320f88f24/dataviz && P="#2a78d6,#eb6834,#1baf7a,#eda100,#e87ba4,#008300,#6250d6,#e34948"; node scripts/validate_palette.js "$P" --mode light 2>&1 | tail -40; echo "===== DARK ====="; D="#3987e5,#d95926,#199e70,#c98500,#d55181,#008300,#9085e9,#e66767"; node scripts/validate_palette.js "$D" --mode dark 2>&1 | tail -40

C=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm; rg -n "legend\?:|enabled\?: boolean" $C/core/types/index.d.ts | head -5; rg -n "export interface ChartLegend" -A12 $C/core/types/chart/*.d.ts | head -20; sed -n '118,135p' $C/core/types/chart/line.d.ts; echo "=== yagr timeline/timeMultiplier and tooltip default ==="; rg -n "timeMultiplier" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/defaults.js | head -3; rg -n "legend|show" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/defaults.js | head -8
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -60; echo "TSC_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
rg -n "ThemeType" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v 'npm warn' | head -60; echo "TSC_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v 'npm warn' | tail -40

npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -v 'npm warn' | tail -40; echo "--- lazy split check: index chunk must not contain chart engine code ---"; for f in dist/assets/index-*.js; do echo "$f: uplot=$(grep -c 'uPlot' $f) d3=$(grep -c 'd3-' $f)"; done

npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v 'npm warn'; echo "TSC_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E 'built in|error|Error' ; echo "--- git ---"; git status --short; cat .gitignore; git diff -- package.json
rm -rf dist && git status --short
